name: Somchai Chancharoen
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he spent several years working on agricultural machinery in rural Thailand. Frustrated with the slow pace of innovation, he took a gamble and moved to Brazil, drawn by the country's vibrant racing scene. He started as a junior mechanic, quickly impressing his superiors with his meticulous approach and problem-solving skills. Over the years, he climbed the ranks, honing his expertise in engine performance and vehicle dynamics. 

Now the chief engineer at Hot Car Competições, Somchai is known for his pragmatic, data-driven approach. He emphasizes reliability and incremental improvements, believing that consistent performance trumps risky gambles. Though not a flashy innovator, his deep understanding of the car and his ability to troubleshoot issues under pressure make him an invaluable asset to the team. He values loyalty and hard work above all else.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A wiry man with a weathered face, Somchai always sports a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on the engine.
Insists on personally inspecting every tire before a race.
